CustomField.formula: IF( Credit_Review__r.Opportunity__r.Syndication_Date__c - Credit_Review__r.Opportunity__r.NF_Decline_Date__c > 0 , TEXT( FLOOR( Credit_Review__r.Opportunity__r.Syndication_Date__c - Credit_Review__r.Opportunity__r.NF_Decline_Date__c ) ) & " days " & TEXT( FLOOR( MOD( (Credit_Review__r.Opportunity__r.Syndication_Date__c - Credit_Review__r.Opportunity__r.NF_Decline_Date__c ) * 24, 24 ) ) ) & " hours " & TEXT( ROUND( MOD( (Credit_Review__r.Opportunity__r.Syndication_Date__c - Credit_Review__r.Opportunity__r.NF_Decline_Date__c ) * 24 * 60, 60 ), 0 ) ) & " minutes", "" )
